name: Altitude limit 120 m (Lito X1)
description: Writes the flight controller parameter g_config.flying_limit.max_height = 120 by name hash (8a237103, value 0x0078 U16 LE) on the unwrapped FLYC inject port 40008 - the way back from altitude_500_lito_x1.json. 120 is the value the parameter holds on a CE unit before any FCC profile (lmdegreeds/dji_fcc_gpsoff doc/config-table-commands.md, before/after dump on RC 2 + Lito X1).

frames.note: FLYCONTROLLER write param by hash: g_config.flying_limit.max_height = 120 (0x0078 LE)
